name: icon-tile
summary: A small colored rounded square behind an icon that gives each nav, menu or settings entry a recognizable color, from the reference's palette pairs.
useWhen: Entries in a sidebar, settings nav or menu benefit from a quick color cue, such as Profile, Subscription and Usage.

alternatives.name: icon
alternatives.when: a plain icon is enough and color would add noise

rules.do: Always pair a tile with a visible text label; the tile is decoration.
rules.dont: Use a tile on its own as a button or as the only way to tell items apart.

rules.do: Give each destination one color and keep it everywhere it appears.
rules.dont: Color tiles randomly or change an item's color between screens.

a11y: Tiles are hidden from screen readers; the label beside them carries the meaning.
Some palette pairs (brown) have low icon contrast, which is acceptable only because tiles are decorative.
